web-guide-idea-100.audience: Creators who benefit from a regular work check-in.
web-guide-idea-100.offer: Host a small accountability group with realistic goals and practical feedback. Your contribution is structure and follow-through.
web-guide-idea-100.steps.0: Ask each creator to choose a measurable weekly task.
web-guide-idea-100.steps.1: Review progress and one obstacle in turn.
web-guide-idea-100.steps.2: Agree a next action and the following check-in.
web-guide-idea-100.equipment: A phone and simple notes or shared tracker with participants’ agreement.
web-guide-idea-100.returnReason: A consistent cadence lets people see their own progress and support one another.
web-guide-idea-100.promotion: Explain the check-in format and time commitment. Avoid promising revenue growth.
